Hello grade four learners. Welcome to Mathematics Lesson for grade four. Today, we shall learn how to tell time in a m and in p m. Learner, how many hours are there in a day? Good. 24 hours. Now, the 24 hours are divided into two equal cycles. Yes, 24 hours are divided in two equal cycles. The first cycle starts from midnight and ends at midday . This is referred to as morning . Yes, morning means from midnight to midday or noon . Learner, Midday is also known as noon. Learner, The time from midnight to Midday is in am cycle. The time from midnight to midday is in A M cycle. Learner, remember a day has 2 equal cycles, meaning that in the first cycle, there 12 hours. The second cycle begins from midday to midnight. The second cycle begins from midday or noon to midnight. The cycle from midday or noon to midnight is referred to as afternoon or evening. The cycle from midday or noon to midnight is referred to as afternoon or evening. Learner, the time from midday or noon to midnight is in p. m. cycle. The time from midday or noon to midnight is in p. m. cycle.

2 ” to allow audio playback Learner, the following activity you do will help you understand further on how to tell time in either A M or P M. Listen attentively to the questions and write your answer in either A M or P M. A. What time do you go to bed? What time do you go to bed? B. What time do you wake up? What time do you wake up? C. What time do you go to school? What time do you go to school? D. What time do you go for lunch? What time do you go for lunch? Learner, if your answer are as below, then you are correct. Question A. You go to bed either at eight p. m. or 9: 00 p. m. or even 10: 00 p. m. For Question B. You wake up either at 5: 00 a. m. or 6. 00 am or even 7. 00 a. m. For question C you go to school at 5. 00 am or 6: 00 am or even 7: 00 a. m. And for question D. you go for lunch at 12. 30 pm. 12. 40 pm, or even 1. 00 pm. Give yourself a pat on the back for a job well done. Learner, one more thing to remember. Telling time in am or pm informs us of the activities we could be doing at that particular time, for example. 7. 30 am, you could be walking to school. But 7. 30 p. m., you could be having dinner at home with your parents or guardians.
